steps.label: Indication for contrast
steps.detail: State which question needs enhancement and which phase answers it.
steps.look: Arterial phase for arteries and hypervascular lesions; portal venous phase for most abdominal organs; delayed phase for excretion and some lesions.
findings: Target: [portal venous organ enhancement]; single portal venous phase at about 70 seconds.
Target: pulmonary arteries; bolus-tracked pulmonary arterial phase.
Target: hypervascular liver lesion; late arterial and portal venous phases.
steps.tip: Choose the phase for the question: a phase that does not show the target gives no benefit for its dose.

steps.label: Kidney function and context
steps.detail: Record eGFR with its date and acute kidney injury status, and other relevant context.
findings: eGFR __ mL/min/1.73 m² on [date]; no acute kidney injury.
Suspected acute kidney injury: creatinine-based eGFR is unreliable.
steps.tip: Creatinine-based eGFR can mislead during evolving acute kidney injury.

steps.label: Previous reaction
steps.detail: Identify the agent, symptoms, severity and timing of any prior reaction.
steps.look: Previous reaction record; do not rely on unspecified "allergy".
findings: Previous [mild urticarial] reaction to [agent] in [year]; [agent change / premedication] according to local protocol.
Shellfish allergy only — not a contrast reaction.
steps.tip: A shellfish allergy alone does not predict an iodinated contrast reaction.

model.reporting_aim: Map target and non-target lesions by organ and compartment so the same lesions are measured each time.

steps.label: Therapy and reference studies
steps.detail: Record the malignancy, treatment and start date, baseline, nadir and criteria used.
steps.look: Baseline study within the protocol window before treatment; nadir is the smallest sum so far.
findings: [Malignancy]; treatment [ ] started [date]; baseline [date]; nadir [date]; RECIST 1.1.
Criteria other than RECIST 1.1 apply: [mRECIST / iRECIST / Choi / Lugano].
steps.tip: Choose the right response system for the tumour and treatment before measuring.

steps.label: Target lesions
steps.detail: Keep the same measurable target lesions: at most five in total and two per organ.
steps.look: Measurable: non-nodal lesion 10 mm or more (longest diameter) on CT with slice thickness 5 mm or less; nodes 15 mm or more short axis.
findings: T1: [liver segment VII], series __ image __: baseline __ mm, nadir __ mm, current __ mm.
T2: [right paratracheal node] (short axis): baseline __ mm, nadir __ mm, current __ mm.
steps.tip: Measure the same lesion in the same way each time; nodes by short axis, other lesions by longest diameter.

steps.label: Sum of diameters
steps.detail: Add the target diameters and compare with baseline (for response) and nadir (for progression).
findings: Sum __ mm: __% from baseline, __% from nadir.
Partial response: 30% or more decrease from baseline.
Progression: 20% or more increase from nadir with at least 5 mm absolute increase.

steps.label: Non-target and new lesions
steps.detail: Assess non-target lesions and unequivocal new lesions separately.
steps.look: Each non-target site; systematic search for new lesions.
steps.normal: Non-target lesions present / stable; no new lesions.
findings: Unequivocal progression of non-target disease: [ ].
New lesion in the [ ] (unequivocal).
Indeterminate new focus in the [ ]; reassess at the next study.
steps.tip: An equivocal new focus is not progression until confirmed.

steps.label: Overall response
steps.detail: Combine target, non-target and new-lesion assessments into the overall category.
findings: Overall response: partial response (PR).
Overall response: stable disease (SD).
Overall response: progressive disease (PD) based on [ ].
